name: Fall Fiesta
category_groups: Nature, Abstract, Landscape, Uplifting, Contemporary, Figurative Abstract
material: Acrylic & gel paste on canvas paper
description: Inspired by the vibrant transition of autumn foliage, this piece captures the warm, earthy tones of fall as they give way to the crisp elegance of winter. Ideal for creating a serene, inviting atmosphere, it’s a perfect addition to a cozy reading nook or any space that celebrates seasonal beauty.
